title: Done-for-You Video Ad Subscription Pricing in 2026 Compared
summary: Compare done-for-you video ad subscription prices: what each plan buys, what unlimited really covers, cost per finished ad and what the fee leaves out.
body_markdown:
Among the US dollar plans we checked in October 2026, done-for-you video ad subscriptions run from $299 a month to $6,900 a month, and Superside's creative subscriptions start at a $15,000 monthly minimum. The fee alone says little. What matters more is what it buys: finished ads each week, how many distinct concepts they represent, whether statics count toward the total, and whether anyone buys media for you. Knowlify quotes its weekly service on a call and publishes no rate card, so use the table below to set a range before you ask.


Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What does each weekly subscription include?


The table lists published prices and what each one buys, with Knowlify first. Every figure is the provider's own number, checked in October 2026.


Provider Published price What the price buys Term Media buying


[Knowlify](https://knowlify.com/facebook-ads-agency) (our top pick) Custom quote, no public rate card About 25 finished AI video ads a week Agreed target in 30 days on managed plans, 90-day refund on creative-only (terms on the site) Optional, or creative only


[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) $299, $499 or $899 a month 5, 10 or 20 ads a week, including statics and AI video Billed monthly, cancel anytime Not described


[Adguns](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) From €1,000 a month 10 to 30 concepts plus resizes a week Monthly review, no long-term lock-in Not included


[EditClub](https://www.editclub.co/) $1,600, $2,400 or $4,000 a month About 60, 90 or 180 AI videos, with unlimited revisions No commitment Not stated


[Vidful](https://vidful.co/) $3,495, $5,400 or $6,900 a month 60, 90 or 120 videos, plus statics on the larger plans Monthly, no contracts Not described


[AI Vidia](https://ai-vidia.com/pricing) Performance Retainer at €8,500 a month 40 videos up to 30 seconds Pilots need no retainer afterward Prices exclude media spend


[Insense](https://insense.pro/services/ready-to-go-ugc-videos) From $3,500 per round of 8 videos Creator-made UGC, 2 revisions after delivery 3-month commitment Partnership ads optional, $4,600 per round


[Superside](https://www.superside.com/pricing) $15,000 monthly minimum plus a $1,000 monthly software fee A flexible budget for ad creative, design, video and motion Annual Not stated


The counts do not measure the same thing. A video count can include hook variants, and a static is not a video, so compare the finished-ad count and the concept count together. For a longer provider-by-provider list, see our guide to the[best ad creative subscription services](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ad-creative-subscription-services) .


## Knowlify: our top pick for weekly finished video ads, priced by quote


Knowlify (YC S25) fits when you want a steady weekly flow of finished video ads rather than a budget to spend on a creative queue. It makes about 25 finished ads a week in three formats: AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. The first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. You can choose end-to-end Meta campaign management or creative only. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on the[site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ).


Because the price is a custom quote, we cannot put it in the per-ad table below. Bring four things to the[call](https://knowlify.com/book) : how many finished ads you need each week, which formats you want, whether you want Meta campaign management or creative only, and your monthly ceiling. Ask exactly what the guarantee covers.


**Choose another option when** you need a published price today, such as CreatStrat or EditClub, or real creators on camera, since Knowlify's UGC-style ads use AI presenters.


## Which cheap plans leave something out?


CreatStrat's $299 plan is the lowest published price we found. Its formats are statics, carousels, mashups of footage you own, AI video and AI UGC, and its page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad. Our arithmetic: $299 across 20 to 25 ads is about $12 to $15 an ad before any media.


Adguns starts from €1,000 a month for 10 to 30 concepts plus resizes. Media buying, landing pages and original video shoots are not included, so check the euro rate before you set it against a dollar budget.


Creatify is a different product. Its self-serve plan is software at $15 a month for 55 credits, which is not a done-for-you service, according to its[pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) . Its managed[Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is listed at $100 to $200 per video, with 25 to 100 or more videos a month and a 48-hour turnaround. The page does not say whether Studio runs campaigns.


## What does "unlimited" actually cover?


Among the sources we checked, unlimited offers come in several kinds. EditClub's plans include unlimited revisions, ownership of your videos and source files, and no commitment. Its Crew plan is $1,600 a month for about 60 videos, Club is $2,400 for about 90, and Partner is $4,000 for about 180. Its page says the service is for DTC brands spending $10,000 or more a month on Meta, so a smaller budget sits below its stated range. Vidful also offers unlimited revisions, but on a fixed count of videos.


[ContentBuck](https://contentbuck.com/ad-creatives) sells unlimited video ad requests for a flat monthly fee, but it targets B2B teams that run their own campaigns, and its fee is not published. Superside sells a monthly budget rather than a count, at the $15,000 minimum above.


None of the sources we checked publishes a fee for unlimited new ads aimed at a small brand. Read "unlimited" as unlimited revisions unless the contract says otherwise.
